items.information:
🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao Primeiro Timbó ao Cubo Open

On-site registration will only be avaible for the 3x3x3 cube event.

items.city: Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro

venue.name: Centro Educacional Paraíso
venue.address: R. Passos, Lote 16 Quadra 67 - Doutor Laureano, Duque de Caxias - RJ, 25051-300

items.information:
**Português**

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes:
- Chegue ao local da competição 20 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
- Procure se divertir bastante!
- Inscrições no dia do campeonato estarão abertas somente para 3x3x3.

**English**
It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions:
- Arrive at the competition 20 minutes before the modality that you will participate;
- The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it;
- If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubers.
- Try to have a lot of fun!
- Entries on the day of the competition will only be open for 3x3x3.

items.information:
## Português
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](link da página de inscrições da sua competição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

## English
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](link da página de inscrições da sua competição) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$20. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: 
bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingHeatRaipur2025#58057-registrations-payments).

Please note once you register on the WCA site for this competition, 
your name will 1st be in the waiting list.
Only once your payment is completed, your name will show up within 48hrs.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New-comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they will have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, 
organisers will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and overall participation.
We will be dividing all the participants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration.

Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.
